cleanup_contract: after every parent exit independently probe owned process group
if any descendant remains TERM then KILL bounded
wait and reprobe until group absent
independently verify recorded child PID absent
only then set process_group_gone child_pid_gone descendants_reaped true
probe failure after admission is durable UNKNOWN
pass_gate: zero-exit parent may PASS only after exact terminal/Ferry/Engine and unconditional group/child cleanup
